title: Belfry Battery vs Flamewrought Company
lede:
The Flamewrought Company won 36-11 on Victory Points at the end of Battle Round 4, holding the centre and the right objective in every round and taking the left in the last.

The Belfry Battery's guns could not take or hold ground: its only objective VP came from the left in Rounds 2 and 3, and in Round 4 the Company took the left as well, from a Covenant Levies squad SUPPRESSED by a natural 1 on its Morale Test.
result_line: Flamewrought Company win 36-11 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Belfry Battery is an artillery army: the Nicomedean Thunder Tower at (3,12), St. Barbara Field Gun 1 at (5,12) and Field Gun 2 at (9,14), the Master Gunner at (11,12) and the Petard Bearer at (9,12), with the Archistrategos leading the Knight-Apostle Squad at (4,12) and the two Covenant Levies at (6,12) and (7,12) as its objective holders. The Flamewrought Company fielded eleven infantry units in its back rows: Ardashir with Javidan Immortals 1 at (5,2), the Mobad with Shieldbearers 1 at (3,2), Javidan Immortals 2 at (9,2), Shieldbearers 2 at (10,2), both Sagdid Hound-Keepers and both Adur Furnace Guard squads. The Battery had Priority with fewer units on the battlefield (10 to 11). The set-up left the Battery's OC in two 10 RP Levies squads against an army whose elite Javidan could walk onto two objectives and stay there.

1.title: The Company takes all three objectives

feed.text: Primaries revealed: ERADICATE THE FOE for the Battery, BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Company. Secondaries kept: INTO THE FRAY and COMMAND AUTHORITY. The Battery spent its 2 CP on Double Time for the Knight-Apostle Squad; the Company spent 3, Double Time on Shieldbearers 2 and a Scouting Order on Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1. The record prices all three at nothing.

Both Covenant Levies walked into the centre's area at 6,7 and 6,8; Ardashir with Javidan Immortals 1 came to 8,6 and Shieldbearers 2 to 8,7 against them. Javidan Immortals 2 took the right at 12,6, the Mobad with Shieldbearers 1 the left at 2,6, and the Knight-Apostle Squad with the Archistrategos came up to 3,8 beside them.

With the Providence Miracle the Knight-Apostle Squad shot Shieldbearers 1 for 8 (10 to 2, four models). Nothing else fired: every other unit on the table had no legal action. The Battery's PRAYING units banked 8 Mana.
The Company scored everything: the centre on OC 25 vs 20, the left on OC 3 vs 0, the right on OC 10 vs 1. 0-7.

2.title: The Archistrategos takes the left; the Javidan take two units

feed.text: The Battery spent 2 CP on Double Time for Covenant Levies 1, the Company 2 CP on Double Time for Ardashir (bought nothing). Both kept VIGILANT WATCH. Shieldbearers 1 failed Morale and were SUPPRESSED.

The Knight-Apostle Squad with the Archistrategos charged the Mobad and Shieldbearers 1: INTO THE FRAY, +2. The Thunder Tower's Overwatch took 2 off Sagdid Hound-Keepers 2 and left them PARALYZED. Javidan Immortals 2 charged St. Barbara Field Gun 2 at 12,9, and Javidan Immortals 1 with Ardashir charged both Covenant Levies at 7,8; Covenant Levies 1 failed its Fall Back test, broke away for 3 True Damage and landed on the left at 2,8. Shieldbearers 2's Overwatch on Covenant Levies 2 completed VIGILANT WATCH for the Company, +1.

Under the Exaltation Miracle the Archistrategos struck first (INI 10 +3) and killed both: the Mobad and Shieldbearers 1 destroyed, two kills in the left Objective Area. Covenant Levies 2 attacked Javidan Immortals 1 and were cut down by the counterattack, 18 damage: Covenant Levies 2 destroyed, and Retribution's last blow did nothing. Javidan Immortals 2 rolled 6 hits on St. Barbara Field Gun 2: destroyed. The Master Gunner took 4 off Shieldbearers 2; the Thunder Tower spent its action on Diffuse Arc.
The Battery took the left on OC 5 vs 0 (2) and ERADICATE THE FOE paid 3 for the two kills; the Company kept the centre on OC 15 vs 0 and the right on OC 10 vs 0, and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 1. 7-14.

3.title: The Knight-Apostles break on the Javidan

feed.text: The Company spent 3 CP on Troop Requisition: Sagdid Hound-Keepers at 3,2. The Benediction Miracle healed Covenant Levies 1 by 1. Secondaries kept: FOCUSED FIRE and DEEP REACH.

The Knight-Apostle Squad with the Archistrategos charged Ardashir, Javidan Immortals 1 and Shieldbearers 2 on the centre at 6,7, under Go to Ground (1 CP) against Ardashir's Overwatch. Shieldbearers 2 failed their Fall Back test (1 True Damage) and went to 2,6. St. Barbara Field Gun 1's Overwatch took 2 off Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1. The Petard Bearer's charge failed.

The Archistrategos used Quis ut Deus? (+2 FR/AR, +2 DMG, LETHAL) for 6 on Javidan Immortals 1 (15 to 9). The counterattacks cost the Battery more: the Javidan 2 and Ardashir 6, both into the Knight-Apostle Squad (12 to 4), which also took BURNED. The Knight-Apostle Squad added 2 (9 to 7). Covenant Levies 1, the Thunder Tower and the Master Gunner all shot Shieldbearers 2: FOCUSED FIRE, +2 VP and +1 CP.
The Battery held the left on OC 4 vs 3 (2). The Company held the centre on OC 11 vs 5 and the right on OC 10 vs 0 (5), BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 1 and DEEP REACH 3. 11-23.

4.title: The left falls and the Company sweeps

feed.text: For TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET the Battery named the left objective, the only one it held. The Battery spent 3 CP on Troop Requisition (Covenant Levies at 6,12), the Company 2 on Double Time for its new Sagdid Hound-Keepers (bought nothing). Covenant Levies 1 rolled a natural 1 on its Morale Test and was SUPPRESSED, OC 0 on the left.

The Knight-Apostle Squad failed its Fall Back test (2 True Damage) and fell back to 5,10. Shieldbearers 2 stepped onto the left at 2,7. Javidan Immortals 1 with Ardashir left the centre and charged the HQ and St. Barbara Field Gun 1 at 7,12, and the two Adur Furnace Guard squads, which took no action all battle, walked into the centre at 6,6 and 5,7. The Petard Bearer's charge failed again.

Javidan Immortals 1 put 4 hits on St. Barbara Field Gun 1: destroyed; Ardashir then started a Capture on the HQ, which is no win condition in Seize the Ground. The Sagdid Hound-Keepers took 3 off the Thunder Tower. BURNED finished the Knight-Apostle Squad and Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1.
The Company held all three: the centre on OC 3 vs 0, the left on OC 4 vs 0, the right on OC 10 vs 0, 7 VP. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for the left and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET 3. 11-36, the Company past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Flamewrought Company took 24 of its 36 VP from objectives: the centre in all four rounds (12), the right in all four (8) and the left in Rounds 1 and 4 (4). BREAK THEIR HOLD added 5, and VIGILANT WATCH, DEEP REACH and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET 7; COMMAND AUTHORITY expired. The Belfry Battery scored 4 objective VP (the left in Rounds 2 and 3), 3 from ERADICATE THE FOE (Round 2's two kills) and 4 from INTO THE FRAY and FOCUSED FIRE. The Company also won the trade: four units and 100 RP destroyed to three units and 47 RP.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

Javidan Immortals 2 stood on the right objective all battle, charging once from it to destroy St. Barbara Field Gun 2: 8.5 VP, all 8 objective VP hinged on it. Javidan Immortals 1 with Ardashir held the centre for three rounds and dealt 25 damage, more than any unit on the table, with two kills: Covenant Levies 2 and St. Barbara Field Gun 1. Shieldbearers 2 (4.8 VP) were the Company's busy piece: VIGILANT WATCH, the left objective in Round 4 and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET.

For the Battery, the Archistrategos was the one unit that won fights: 11 damage, the Mobad and Shieldbearers 1 killed in one strike, and the 3 VP of ERADICATE THE FOE. Covenant Levies 1 held the left for its 4 objective VP. The artillery did almost nothing: the Thunder Tower 5 damage for 45 RP, St. Barbara Field Gun 1 4 for 30 RP, Field Gun 2 none before the Javidan reached it in Round 2, the Master Gunner 4.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Battery could not do

It could not put OC on the objectives. Its OC was two 10 RP Covenant Levies and the Knight-Apostle Squad; Covenant Levies 2 died in Round 2, the Knight-Apostles were broken in the centre in Round 3, and the SUPPRESSED Covenant Levies 1 counted 0 in Round 4. Even unsuppressed, its OC 4 would only have tied the Company's 4 on the left, and the Company had two units there to its one. The guns did not make up for it: the Company's infantry reached them by Round 2 (Javidan Immortals 2 cut St. Barbara Field Gun 2 down in melee), and the guns that survived rolled few dice for little damage. The Battery also banked 16 Mana from PRAYING and never had a way to spend it: no unit in the preset is a MAGIC_CASTER, so the Antiphonary is closed to this army.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • The Company's two Adur Furnace Guard squads (40 RP) took no action in four rounds, every round with no legal action; they mattered only by walking onto the centre in Round 4. The Battery's Petard Bearer (15 RP) took no action either and failed two charges.
  • Round 2, the Thunder Tower spent its action on Diffuse Arc; the record prices it at nothing.
  • Round 1's three commands (Double Time on each side and the Company's Scouting Order, 5 CP) bought nothing.
  • Round 4, the Battery's TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET pick was the right one: the left was the only objective the Company did not hold. It was lost to the Morale roll, not the pick.

How sure: this one is the army. The Battery's 250 RP is mostly guns that do not hold objectives, facing eleven infantry units on a map where they close in two rounds. The AI's idle units on the Company's side did not matter to the result.

closing: The Flamewrought Company walked its Javidan onto two objectives in Round 1 and never left them. The Belfry Battery's Archistrategos won the one fight it picked, but the Battery's guns hit too little and its three objective holders were gone or broken by Round 4.
